result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.simrank_star_similarity_pair()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Compute SimRank* similarity between a specific pair of nodes. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L11247-L11311){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.simrank_star_similarity_pair( source, target, importance_factor=0.8, max_iterations=100, tolerance=1e-06, method="closed_form", ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![SimRank* similarity for one pair](/assets/graphs/simrank-star-similarity-pair.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="Nodes B and E are outlined in the accent color; the short paths between them through C and D are in accent. SimRank* counts paths of every length, decayed by the factor C = 0.8 per step, and the card returns a score of 0.356 for the pair." width="100%"} This is more efficient than computing the full similarity matrix when only one pair is needed, though internally it still computes the full matrix. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [source]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : First node (ID or label). [target]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Union[int, str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Second node (ID or label). [importance_factor]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0.8]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Decay factor `C` in `[0, 1)`. Default is `0.8`. [max_iterations]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[100]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Maximum iterations for the `"iterative"` solver. [tolerance]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[1e-06]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Convergence threshold for the `"iterative"` solver. [method]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["closed_form"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : `"closed_form"` (default) or `"iterative"`. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Similarity score in `[0, 1]`. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#95cb5656 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec g = ec.Graph(directed=True) for i in range(1, 5): g.add_node(label=str(i)) g.add_edge("1", "2").add_edge("1", "3") g.add_edge("2", "4").add_edge("3", "4") g.simrank_star_similarity_pair("2", "3") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 0.07407407407407407 ``` ::: :::
